outcome: Accuracy of three-dimensional multislice view Doppler in diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 78 pregnant women with persistent placenta previa totalis (after 28 weeks' gestation).
finding: Three-dimensional multislice view Doppler showed high accuracy (91%) in diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum, with disruption of the uterine serosa-bladder interface being the best single criterion.
